description: Na₃AlF₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 32°. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.22 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent F atoms. There are three shorter (2.25 Å) and three longer (2.50 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Al is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 32°. All Al-F bond lengths are 1.81 Å. F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Al atom.
